newFeatures: JWT authentication with Librarian/Member RBAC: login, member self-registration, librarian-only staff provisioning; every catalog/member/borrowing/dashboard/jobs/logs endpoint now requires a bearer token (Books stays browsable read-only by Members; everything else is Librarian-only)

Book catalog enrichment: cover thumbnail (explicit URL or a derived Open Library cover-by-ISBN fallback), optional edition, ebook/audiobook availability flags with URLs, external buy/PDF suggestion links, and a new book detail page resolving smart availability (physical -> ebook -> audiobook -> external suggestion); Members see a read-only catalog with no mutating actions
Book-copy auto-generation: creating a book with TotalCopies > 0 generates that many BookCopy rows in one transaction with sequential barcodes (BC-0001, BC-0002, ...), continuing the existing sequence
Borrow limit raised from 1 to 2 active books per member, and made configurable (Borrowing:MaxActiveBorrowsPerMember)
Member list shows a currently-borrowing indicator per member (batched, not N+1); the Active/Suspended/Inactive status filter already existed and was verified working

Member borrow-request / librarian-approval workflow: a member can request to borrow an existing title or suggest a purchase; a librarian approval queue approves (issuing the book immediately if a copy is available, via the existing BorrowingService) or rejects
Borrowing page now shows real member names and book titles instead of truncated GUIDs, with a client-side search box across member name, membership number, book title and copy barcode
In progress: this is 8 of 9 smart-library milestones - only voice search and an agentic chat assistant remain, see docs/ai-handover.md §4i for the exact plan
PBKDF2 password hashing, a users table/migration, and a full bilingual login/registration SPA flow with role-based navigation and route guarding

OpenAPI/Scalar now renders a title and description for every endpoint (XML doc file enabled); Postman collection (postman/) with runnable example requests for all 43 endpoints plus a verified end-to-end Smoke Flow folder
Soft delete on every entity (Domain.Common.Entity base) - nothing is physically removed; deleted rows are hidden from reads, search, duplicate checks and aggregates
Smart cascade delete: DELETE /api/{books|members|book-copies}/{id}?force= - borrowed dependents block, other dependents ask to confirm, force cascades in one transaction
Book.Category / Book.Publisher and Member.Phone / Member.Address across domain, DTOs, validators, Excel templates, seed and frontend
Dapper read-path for the dashboard aggregate (Database:Orm=Dapper, Postgres/SQLite)
Per-client rate limiting (forwarded-header aware) returning 429 problem+json with Retry-After
RFC 7807 application/problem+json failure responses with success/errors/correlationId extension members
Resource-based localization: English (default) + Bangla, fallback English; GET /api/metadata/messages returns the localized error-code map; frontend EN/বাংলা switch across the entire UI chrome
Frontend Vitest test suite wired into CI
GitLab-style advanced search, all-or-nothing Excel bulk import, member lifecycle + manual maintenance job (from 0.3.0)
EF Core + PostgreSQL with configuration-only provider switching, OpenTelemetry/Jaeger, dockerised stack, GitHub Actions CI (from 0.3.0)
fixed: appsettings.Development.json had Database:Provider "PostgreSql" (a typo not matching the Postgres enum name), which silently fell back to InMemory - Development had never actually been exercising Postgres; also fixed its connection string (wrong port/credentials)
A hardcoded English network/server-error fallback message that rendered regardless of the active language - moved to a locale key
A member's own borrow-request list showed a blank book title (only the librarian queue had the name/title enrichment lookup) - fixed with a regression test
The 0.2.0 backend is now built, tested and verified (98 backend + 11 frontend tests)
changedBehaviour: Every endpoint except /api/auth/*, /api/metadata/* and /api/release-notes/* now requires an Authorization: Bearer <token> header, or returns 401
Borrow-limit conflict messages now say "at most N book(s)" instead of "only one active borrow"
Create/Update Book requests require Category and Publisher; Create/Update Member requests require Phone and Address
DELETE endpoints accept an optional ?force= query parameter
BorrowingController conflicts return HTTP 409 with the standard envelope (was 400)
qaChecklist: frontend npm test -> 11/11; npm run lint + npm run build clean
POST /api/auth/login with the seeded librarian/member accounts returns a bearer token; wrong password returns 400 with the standard error envelope
a Member token gets 403 on a Librarian-only endpoint and 200 browsing /api/books

browser end-to-end: auth flows for both roles; book cover rendering + the DDD no-physical-copy-> external-buy-link fallback; the full borrow-request -> approve -> fulfilled workflow; borrowing page shows names not GUIDs - 0 console errors in every pass
cascade delete: blocked / confirm / force paths
soft-deleted rows excluded from search, duplicate checks and dashboard
rate limiting returns 429 after the window; RFC 7807 problem+json shape
localization: en/bn message catalogue via ?culture= and Accept-Language, full UI chrome including the new pages
Dapper vs EF dashboard aggregate parity
advanced search operators + enum-by-name; all ten bulk-import acceptance scenarios
docker compose up --build -> /health healthy, web proxies API, Jaeger receives traces
all three new migrations (AddUsers, AddBookCatalogEnrichment, AddBorrowRequests) applied cleanly to a real local Postgres
knownIssues: Voice search (Web Speech API + Hugging Face, configurable) and an agentic chat assistant (rule-based + Anthropic/OpenAI, configurable) are not yet built - see docs/ai-handover.md §4i for the exact plan
Database:Orm=Dapper covers the dashboard aggregate; other read paths use EF Core
No EF Core 10 driver for MySQL/Oracle yet (provider slots + ADR-0001 ready)
